what: Chapter 04 of the introduction, "Every battery planned for tomorrow", as a 5 s loop for the chapter panes: the beat at the site's rest, drawn without its caption, scope line or plates, the camera drifting round its rest pose and back. Positions are schematic, as in the story.
name: Every battery planned for tomorrow

code.world: packages/world as the commit holds it

render.command: packages/world: sh scripts/serve.sh <port>; site: WORLD_BROWSER_LIB=<launcher> node scripts/render-chapters.mjs --port <port> --loops starting-grid --seconds 5 --fps 30
render.page: src/story/story.html?mode=capture&cut=master&w=1920&h=1080&captions=none, the player set to the site's stops
